theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_cz_top_density_orient_sign
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid n)) (R : IMRep V n), ∃ σ : Euclid n → ℝ, Measurable σ ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), (σ y = 1 ∨ σ y = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid n) n, R.orient y α = σ y * α ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)
